plugins.name: pipeline-orchestrator
plugins.description: Single-command multi-agent pipeline for Claude Code. v5.0.0 — first major release. All 7 v5.0 DoD criteria DONE: 5 commands in /help, TRACE.md by default, TRACE.md attachable to PR via standalone validator, compat suite green for 5 canonical scenarios, v5.1 milestone published with YAML interpreter commitment (milestone #1, target Q3 2026), plan-mode-enforcer auto-triggers on MEDIA + COMPLEXA, pipeline-controller declares spawn tools explicitly. Suite at v5.0.0: 166 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 SKIPPED unit+integration + 5 PASS / 1 SKIPPED compat mock + 8/8 hooks syntax. The v5.0.0 release content is identical to v5.0.0-rc.1 (`d643e80`) — promotion was authorized 2026-05-06. v4.17.0 (Wave 8-spec — TRACE.md schema + writer + standalone validator + plan-mode auto-trigger + --no-plan bypass): closes 3 v5.0 DoD criteria in one wave (#2 TRACE.md by default in user repo, #3 attachable to PR via standalone validator, #6 plan-mode-enforcer auto-triggers on MEDIA + COMPLEXA with asymmetric --no-plan override semantics — COMPLEXA always runs plan-architect, override flag is logged for audit). Adds references/trace-schema/v1.md (SSOT, schema_version=1), scripts/validate-trace.cjs (pure-Node validator, exit 0/1 with stderr diff), tests/integration/trace-writer.test.js (7 tests), tests/unit/validate-trace.test.js (5 tests), tests/unit/plan-mode-trigger.test.js (5 tests, 4-combination matrix). Modifies agents/core/pipeline-controller.md Phase 3 closure with new Step 3b-post (TRACE.md emitter wired between final-validator and finishing-branch); modifies commands/pipeline.md Phase 1.5 trigger; corrects designs/pipeline-orchestrator-v5-consolidated.md §8 prose. Iron Law respected: ZERO changes to gate registry (still 22 in references/gates.md), sentinel checkpoints, or agent dispatch namespace; default behavior (no --no-plan) preserves v4.16.0 EXACTLY for SIMPLES and COMPLEXA; MEDIA gets plan-architect for the FIRST TIME (additive). Suite stays GREEN: 166 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 SKIPPED unit+integration (+17 from v4.16.0 baseline) + 5 PASS / 1 SKIPPED compat mock + 8/8 hooks syntax. v4.16.0 (Wave 8-pre): real-mode compat runner via PreToolUse hook contract (Issue #11). v4.15.0 (Wave 7-spec): MIGRATION-v4-to-v5.md + v5 readiness report. v4.14.0 (Wave 6-spec): integration tests + bad-variant fixtures. v4.13.0 (Wave 5-spec): gates registry +6, Inline Invariants 22, mode_used persistence. v4.12.0 (Wave 4-spec): /spec entry-point + 3 pipeline composition refs. v4.11.0 (Wave 3-spec): Spec Classifier Routing. v4.10.0 (Wave 3): Compat Baselines. v4.9.x: spec workflow polish + CI debt. v4.9.0: Spec Workflow Wave 2 — 3 skill trees. v4.8.0 (Hook Enforcement). v4.7.0 (Slice 3b polish). v4.6.1 (Slice 3b corrected). v4.5.0 (Slice 3a). v4.4.x (Slice 1.5). v4.3.x (skill migration). v4.2.x (SEC + thin entry-points). DoD v5.0 status post-Wave-8-spec: 7/7 DONE — v5.0.0-rc.1 tagged 2026-05-06 (1-2 week feedback window, then v5.0.0 final).

Hot-path hook 387→85 lines via lib/advisor-nudge-core extraction; 4 architectural guards CI-enforced (DI-1 module-load purity, DI-2 layered dependency direction, DI-3 manifest version coherence, vault env single source); module-scoped mtime+size cache for embeddings/graph; unified filesystem walker; 812 tests (+24% from 654). BREAKING (restorable): default prompt-length threshold 5→12 chars; restore via ADVISOR_PROMPT_LENGTH=5. Deprecation runway through 0.6.0 for SKILL_ADVISOR_VAULT (use SKILL_ADVISOR_VAULT_PATH) and build-index.inferCategory re-export.
